text:
emma: FYI I walked a customer through the web quickstart using the Okta magic link. First request immediately returned a terse 'Request failed (403)' toast with zero context.

emma: looking at the network tab the body is `\{"error\":\"workspace_billing_required\",\"why\":\"no_payment_method\"\}` but the UI just shows the generic toast. New users won't know to go to the console.

onboard-bot: Hi @emma  new workspaces require a billing method before hosted endpoints are enabled. Add billing here: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/magic123/billing :credit_card:

raj: thanks for reporting. Which quickstart variant was this (react/vue/static) and did the user hit Run immediately after accepting the invite?

emma: react starter, they clicked the magic link -> accept ToS -> landed on the page -> clicked Run. We later attached billing but the app didn't auto-recover.

lucy: short-term workaround for customers: run the dev server with a service key locally to bypass workspace gating: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx && npm start`. Or attach billing and hard-refresh the page.

lucy: but for onboarding we should do three small fixes:
1) client maps `workspace_billing_required` -> persistent inline banner with clear copy + direct Console button,
2) server include `x-redwood-why: billing_required` header in 403s for non-JS clients,
3) add a lightweight retry flow that re-checks auth/state when billing is attached (websocket or short poll).

raj: +1. I'll open a tiny starter-repo PR to add the banner + a retry check that pings `/v1/health` once per 3s for 20s when user clicks "Retry". PR #711.

emma: nice. can the banner also surface the exact error code so support can copy/paste it into tickets? helps triage.

devx-bot: Created INF-900: "add x-redwood-why header + onboard telemetry for billing-required 403s" assigned to @raj.

raj: I'll add telemetry event `onboard.missing_billing` with the error code and auth path (magic_link/browser_oauth/service_key) so support can filter.

lucy: docs: add a one-liner to the quickstart README about magic-link/SSO timing and billing attachment. Also add a short Help Center blurb for customers who accept invites before billing is added.

emma: confirmed service-key workaround unblocked their testing. leaving this thread open until PR + infra ticket merge and docs update.

raj: ETA: PR + infra ticket links in here by EOD tomorrow. Will follow up with screenshots of the banner copy. :thumbsup:
